purpose: Turn FIELD COAXIALITY invariants A-H into a repo-level keep/repair/delete gate. The audit validates claims; it does not create a UI, state store, semantic mapping, or execution authority.

verdicts.PASS: The named criterion is directly supported by durable repo evidence.
verdicts.INDETERMINATE: Required evidence is absent or insufficient. INDETERMINATE is never promoted to PASS.

decision_rule.REPAIR_OR_DELETE: One or more of A-G FAIL. Repair only the failed invariant(s); otherwise delete/de-coaxialize the mechanism.
decision_rule.DECOAXIALIZE_OR_DELETE: H_COMPRESSION FAIL: restore ordinary controls/structure or remove the mechanism. Novelty is not sufficient justification.
decision_rule.PROVE_OR_DECOAXIALIZE: No FAIL exists but at least one criterion is INDETERMINATE. Supply bounded evidence; otherwise fall back to a simpler non-coaxial form.

tests.pass: Canonical/host state is representable and testable without the rendering or geometric projection.
tests.fail: Changing/removing the view destroys, manufactures, or becomes the only representation of canonical state.

tests.pass: Relative meaning is supplied by an explicit host/domain mapping over neutral carrier relations.
tests.fail: Carrier geometry, angle, distance, nesting, animation, or default labels directly manufacture domain verbs/meaning.

tests.pass: Each physical gesture has one primary interpretation; any secondary coupling is explicit and visible.
tests.fail: One gesture silently selects+navigates, mutates unrelated axes, or changes multiple authorities.

tests.pass: ROUTE/SCALE/FOLD/BLOOM preserve the addressed referent unless an explicit traversal changes it.
tests.fail: Projection/scale/compression silently swaps the referent or loses the exact address.

tests.pass: Cheap/local transforms are reversible, or FOLD retains named residue sufficient for exact or declared-tolerance BLOOM.
tests.fail: Compression/transformation destroys state required to reopen, reverse, or explain the loss.

tests.pass: Time/driver inputs retain source/user/system provenance and borrowed clock never becomes borrowed authorship.
tests.fail: Animation/time input obscures who/what drove the state or promotes an external clock/model to author.

tests.pass: RETURN can explain causation using before + operation + actor/driver + delta + after + provenance.
tests.fail: History is destination-only, decorative, or cannot reconstruct why the present state exists.

tests.pass: Compared with a named plain/non-coaxial baseline, the mechanism removes more exposed interaction/learning burden than it adds while retaining required function.
tests.fail: The mechanism adds equal/greater control, explanation, memory, or navigation burden than the baseline.

scope.admission: Register only mechanisms that actually claim a shared held manipulation space. Neutral carrier libraries are audited through their hosts, not treated as independently justified UI.

carrier_exclusions.reason: The library exposes cyclic coordinates/relations but owns no domain meaning, mutation, RETURN, or user-facing compression claim. Its host must satisfy A-H.

mechanisms.claim: Two dial positions share one held relative-state space; the host maps neutral SAME/NEAR/FAR/OPPOSITE relations to BLOOM/FOLD/RETURN/SPLIT.
mechanisms.repair_boundary: Retain the neutral relation carrier and host-owned mapping. Before this mechanism may claim COAXIALITY PASS, repair causal RETURN (G), prove/repair E and F as needed, then compare user-visible burden against a plain control baseline for H. If H fails, de-coaxialize/delete rather than add explanation chrome.
